decision: Payout math is a five-step money flow: sales → 30-day window → confirmed → tax and fees → payout
why: Creators and finance ask the same question ('why is it less than my sales?'); the flow answers it in one line.
value: Fewer payout tickets, and finance can reconcile at a glance.

decision: Reversals arrive as commission.reversed events (a Counter refund, a leak) and reduce the payout before it locks
why: Because commission confirms after the return window, a return is a reversal of unpaid money, never a clawback.
alternative: Pay on order and claw back later.
value: No negative balances and no creator ever owes Maré money.

decision: Approve stays disabled until the checklist passes (contracts, Pix keys, reversals, tax)
why: Paying the wrong key is unrecoverable; the checklist makes the risky items impossible to skip.
value: Mistakes are prevented, not apologized for.

decision: The AI review flags anomalies (a Pix key changed from a new device) and offers a hold, never an automatic change
why: Account-takeover fraud targets payouts; a hold is safe and reversible, a change is not.
value: Fraud caught at the last safe moment with a person deciding.

decision: Approval needs a second factor and each payout is idempotent per creator and week
why: Retries after a timeout are normal; the key guarantees a retry can never pay twice.
alternative: Rely on operators not clicking twice.
value: Safe retries and a clean audit trail.
